page_purpose: Present 1969 as a complete RetroVerse 1969 cover page, with page-aware artwork under real typography and no text baked into the illustration layer for `cover`.
page_intent_readback: Present 1969 as a complete RetroVerse 1969 cover page, with page-aware artwork under real typography and no text baked into the illustration layer for `cover`.
composition_type: full-page cover scene with protected masthead and cover-line zones

art_zone_dimensions.purpose: Background illustration layer beneath final layout typography.

color_palette: warm paper stock, halftone black, amber, teal, and late-70s saturated accent colors
scene_description: A full-page 1969 city-at-night montage with music, film, and neon street energy arranged as one editorial cover scene.
visual_hierarchy: Secondary props reinforce `cover` without competing with text zones.
Negative space stays calm inside title, body, sidebar, and footer zones.
Top-of-page breathing room is reserved for the masthead and primary cover lines.
optional_easter_egg_guidance: Optional and subtle only: a tiny RetroVerse Easter egg may appear as environmental detail, but it must never behave like final page typography.
studio_role_responsibility: Own cover-scale compositions with strong focal contrast, broad scene storytelling, and clear masthead breathing room.
studio_style_rules: Design for a full-page magazine cover, not an insert illustration.
Hold the top third open enough for masthead and cover-line placement.
Favor one dominant scene with secondary supporting details rather than a busy collage of unrelated moments.
text_rendering_instruction: DO NOT RENDER FINAL TEXT INTO THE ARTWORK
